1. `health.ts`: `findIssues(ledger, today)` returns issues, each with `kind`, `count`, `detail`, and the view to open. Use the existing functions. Kinds:   - Rows waiting in review (no `entryId` or `settlementId`, not skipped), with the oldest date.   - A `checkpointDifferences(ledger, accountId)` result whose `differenceCents` is not zero.   - A gap from `accountCoverage(ledger, accountId).gaps`.   - An item from `openItems(ledger, entityId)` older than 60 days, per entity.   - A `splitwisePosts` item in `unknown` or `posting` state, or a `splitwiseInbox` item with status `new`, `changed`, or `deleted`.   - An amended amount with no note.   - A possible double entry: a manual entry and a bank-row entry on the same account, same date, same amount.2. `HealthView.tsx`: issues grouped by kind. Keep the handle in memory.   - On each `save` and `saveAs` with a folder chosen, also write `ledger-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.finance.json`. A failed backup shows a warning but never fails the save.   - Keep the newest 20 files matching that pattern. Delete older matches only.   - Without the API, say backups need Chrome or Edge.4. `DataView.tsx` gets optional props `onChooseBackupFolder` and `onRestore(ledger)`.
